title.narrative: Skills Enhancement for Inclusive and Green Economic Development Project

description.narrative: The proposed project is aligned with the following impact: labor productivity enhanced, and economic competitiveness strengthened (TVET Development Plan 20212025). The project outcome is: TVET programs aligned with evolving labor market needs. The project outputs are: (i) quality and relevance of TVET for selected occupational areas enhanced, (ii) institutional capacity strengthened, (iii) access to quality TVET expanded, and (iv) TVET for female students improved.
